Get started (once):
  clize login                      sign in (browser authorization; the first login creates your account)
  clize claim <slug> --email       free identity <slug>.clize.app: a site + a support@ inbox
  clize init --handle <slug>       bind this directory (deploy / send / inbox then need no arguments)
  clize status                     who is waiting, this month's spend; every session starts here
More: clize <command> --help
